# Gateverse

> Gateverse (جيت فيرس) is a real estate experience studio based in Alexandria, Egypt. It creates immersive digital experiences that help real estate developers, property marketing companies and architecture firms showcase, present and market their projects: 360° virtual tours of completed properties, 3D architectural walkthroughs, off-plan project experiences, interactive property showrooms, interactive masterplans and digital property presentations. Experiences open in any browser on phones, tablets, computers and large displays, with no app.

The website is in English (https://www.gateverse.net/) and Arabic (https://www.gateverse.net/ar). Service is available in English and Arabic.

## Solutions

- [360° Virtual Property Tours](https://www.gateverse.net/solutions/360-virtual-tours): on-site 360° capture of completed apartments, villas, show units, commercial units and amenities, published as a navigable tour with a permanent share link, an embed code, optional information points, in-tour contact buttons (WhatsApp, call, website) and a private statistics page (views, button taps, information points opened). Standard tours are delivered within 48 hours of the capture session.
- [3D Architectural Walkthroughs](https://www.gateverse.net/solutions/3d-walkthroughs): guided walkthrough videos, interactive 360° viewpoints and still renders produced from the client's 3D models or CAD plans, for launches, investor presentations, design review and sales centres.
- [Off-Plan Project Experiences](https://www.gateverse.net/solutions/off-plan-experiences): render-based 360° experiences of units, amenities and views for projects that are still on paper or under construction.
- [Interactive Property Showrooms](https://www.gateverse.net/solutions/interactive-showrooms): a digital showroom of units, specifications and finishing options, captured on site or rendered from design files, for sales centres, client meetings and remote buyers.
- [Interactive Masterplans](https://www.gateverse.net/solutions/interactive-masterplans): masterplans as interactive maps of phases, buildings and amenities, linked to the 360°, off-plan and walkthrough experiences behind them.
- Digital Property Presentations: presentation-ready packages of walkthrough video, stills and interactive links for sales decks, websites and campaigns.

## Who it is for

Real estate developers; property marketing companies; architecture and design studios; residential, commercial and luxury property developers; hospitality and resort developers presenting real estate projects.

## How a project works

1. Discovery: understand the property, project and marketing objectives.
2. Content collection: photography, 360° captures, architectural plans or 3D renders.
3. Experience production: build the immersive digital experience.
4. Review and refinement: review with the client and apply agreed revisions.
5. Launch: deliver a shareable experience ready for websites, campaigns and sales presentations.

## Pricing

Project solutions are customised according to project scale, content requirements and interactive features, and are quoted per project ([request a proposal](https://www.gateverse.net/contact)).

For single completed spaces in Alexandria there are fixed entry-level 360° packages by area ([entry-level packages](https://www.gateverse.net/pricing)): up to 100 m² 950 EGP, up to 150 m² 1,950 EGP, up to 250 m² 2,950 EGP, up to 450 m² 4,950 EGP, each with 1 to 4 months of hosting included, then 100 EGP per month or 1,000 EGP per year. Larger spaces are quoted individually.

## Work

- [Concept apartment](https://www.gateverse.net/portfolio#concept): an interactive render-based 360° experience of a CG apartment (a concept demonstration, not a client project), based on "Apartamento" by SrMonteiro, CC BY 4.0.
- [The Circle](https://www.gateverse.net/tour/the-circle): live 360° tour of a workspace in Alexandria, captured on site.
- [Shaghof](https://www.gateverse.net/tour/shaghof): live 360° tour of a cultural venue in Alexandria, captured on site.
- [King Gym](https://www.gateverse.net/tour/king-gym): live 360° tour of a fitness facility in Alexandria, captured on site.

## Coverage

Based in Alexandria, Egypt, where on-site capture is carried out; capture elsewhere is discussed per project. Render-based work (off-plan experiences, 3D walkthroughs, interactive masterplans) is produced from project files and can serve developers in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and beyond. Working hours: Sunday to Thursday, 09:00 to 18:00 (Cairo time).
